title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member III - Guidewire and React Developer
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

This position collaborates with business stakeholders, solution engineers, product owners, UX designers, and Agile teams to design, develop, test, and deploy end-to-end insurance solutions using Guidewire PolicyCenter and modern React-based digital applications. The role combines hands-on Guidewire configuration and integration development with front-end engineering skills in React, JavaScript or TypeScript, REST API integration, responsive user experiences, and automated testing. Experience with Guidewire Jutro Digital Platform, ProducerEngage, or other Guidewire digital applications is preferred. The developer delivers maintainable, secure, accessible, and production-ready functionality each sprint with support and limited guidance from senior developers, solution engineers, or architects.

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

* Develops and configures Guidewire PolicyCenter components and React-based web applications to deliver end-to-end business functionality.
* Translates business and user experience requirements into maintainable back-end, integration, and front-end components aligned with architectural direction and engineering standards.
* Builds reusable React components, screens, forms, and workflows using modern JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or SCSS, and approved component libraries.
* Integrates digital applications with Guidewire and enterprise services using REST APIs, Guidewire Cloud APIs, Digital SDKs where applicable, messaging, and secure authentication patterns.
* Reviews and validates code, configuration, component design, automated tests, and supporting documentation produced by team members.
* Develops secure and reliable application components with attention to performance, accessibility, error handling, observability, restart and recovery, and efficient resource utilization.
* Performs impact assessments across business processes, data, Guidewire configuration, APIs, integrations, digital channels, and downstream systems before implementing changes.
* Creates unit, component, integration, and end-to-end tests and applies Test-Driven Development or Behavior-Driven Development practices where appropriate.
* Supports implementation and release activities, troubleshoots environment and production issues across Guidewire and React applications, performs root cause analysis, and implements corrective actions.
* Uses source control, code quality tools, test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment tooling to improve delivery quality and efficiency.
* Provides limited technical guidance, knowledge sharing, code review support, and mentoring to junior team members when needed.

  
**Requirements**  

**Guidewire Technical Requirements**
------------------------------------

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, solution engineering, or a related technology field.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with Guidewire products, preferably PolicyCenter, including configuration and integration development.
* Experience configuring PolicyCenter product model, business rules, workflows, user interface components, data model extensions, and validation logic using Gosu and Guidewire standards.
* Experience developing PCF components, business rules, data model extensions, plugins, and automated unit tests such as GUnit tests.
* Experience integrating PolicyCenter with digital portals and enterprise systems using REST services, Guidewire APIs, messaging, events, message queues, plugins, and batch processes.
* Working knowledge of Guidewire Cloud or SaaS delivery practices, including automated build, test, deployment, environment support, and application monitoring.
* Advanced Product Designer experience is preferred.
* Property and casualty insurance knowledge, including products, coverages, underwriting processes, policy transactions, and integration touchpoints.

**React and Digital Experience Requirements**
---------------------------------------------

* Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience developing production web applications using React and modern JavaScript; TypeScript experience is preferred.
* Strong understanding of React functional components, hooks, component composition, state management, routing, reusable design patterns, and front-end error handling.
* Experience with HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, SCSS or CSS modules, browser developer tools, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs, handling asynchronous operations, transforming JSON payloads, and implementing authentication and authorization in web applications.
* Experience writing front-end unit and component tests using tools such as Jest and React Testing Library; experience with end-to-end automation is preferred.
* Working knowledge of Node.js, npm, package and dependency management, bundling or build tooling, linting, code formatting, and front-end CI/CD practices.
* Ability to apply accessibility, internationalization, performance, security, and responsive design practices to customer- and producer-facing applications.
* Experience working with UX designers and translating Figma designs or design-system specifications into reusable, accessible React components.
* Experience with Guidewire Jutro Framework (Producer Engage or JDP) is a plus.

**Agile Delivery and Collaboration**
------------------------------------

* Writes and refines user stories with clear technical tasks and acceptance criteria covering Guidewire, API, React, and integration changes; estimates work and identifies delivery risks.
* Partners with Product Owners, UX designers, solution engineers, and QA team members to confirm that implementation and tests reflect intended business and user experience outcomes.
* Participates in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, system demos, retrospectives, and Inspect and Adapt activities.
* Commits to team PI objectives and sprint goals, communicates progress and impediments, and takes ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration, and continuous deployment to support the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps.
* Demonstrates integrated PolicyCenter and digital functionality to Product and Business Owners and supports iteration and PI System Demos.
* Shares Guidewire and React engineering practices, contributes to Communities of Practice, and supports continuous improvement and development of T-shaped skills.

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Strong verbal, written, listening, and presentation skills, with the ability to adjust technical detail for business and technical audiences.
* Excellent collaboration and team-building skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders and provide meaningful feedback.
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down moderately complex issues, determine root cause, compare alternatives, and recommend viable solutions.
* Strong ownership and accountability for individual and team deliverables, including timely identification and correction of gaps.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity, changing priorities, and multiple concurrent assignments.
* Working knowledge of software design principles, object-oriented and component-based programming, defensive coding, error handling, version control, database concepts, SQL, and CI/CD.
* Ability to train and mentor others in areas of expertise and provide constructive technical guidance.

**Education and Certification Requirements**
--------------------------------------------

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field preferred.
* SAFe Practitioner or SAFe Agilist certification within 180 days of hire required.
* Guidewire Configuration or Integration certification required or expected based on organizational standards.
* Relevant React, JavaScript, TypeScript, cloud, or web development training or certification is preferred.

  
**Benefits**

Competitive compensation and benefits package:

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Training & Development

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

**About Capgemini**

Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22.5 billion in revenues in 2023.

* Develop and maintain React micro-frontend solutions and web applications for a payments platform.
* Add new payment methods to existing platform capabilities.
* Deliver features, bug fixes, and reliability improvements.
* Deliver production-ready changes through automated CI/CD pipelines with strong test coverage.
* Write comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to support application reliability.

 **Qualifications**

**Must-Have Skills**

* BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience at a mid-to-senior level, with demonstrated ownership of production services in a distributed systems environment.
* TypeScript and React, including functional components, hooks, context, and custom hooks.
* Webpack bundling and code splitting, with component styling using SCSS/CSS Modules and Styled Components.
* Experience building and maintaining micro-frontends using Webpack Module Federation or similar platform-integrated remote module architectures.
* Strong working knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations, Apollo Client caching and reactive variables, and type-safe hooks generated with GraphQL Code Generator or similar tooling.
* Solid React Router experience for client-side navigation, plus experience building and validating complex forms.
* Production engineering experience with frontend telemetry, error logging, feature flags, gradual rollouts, and debugging user-facing production issues.
* Experience building accessible and internationalized interfaces using shared design systems, reusable component libraries, and localization workflows.
* Unit and integration testing with Jest and React Testing Library; end-to-end testing with TestCafe, Cypress, or Playwright; and familiarity with automated accessibility testing tools.
* CI/CD experience with GitLab CI or equivalent, plus ESLint, Prettier, and collaborative Git workflows including branching, code reviews, and merge requests.
* Responsible use of modern coding assistants for code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, and test creation while retaining ownership of quality, security, and correctness.
* Strong working knowledge of backend and distributed systems, including asynchronous messaging and multi-datastore consistency. End-to-end ownership of backend systems is not required, but limited understanding of these concepts is insufficient.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Prior billing or payments domain experience.
* Experience with high-scale, mission-critical frontend systems where user experience, state-management correctness, accessibility, and performance are essential.
* Clear reasoning about client-side architecture, including micro-frontends, module federation, and caching strategies.
* Strong collaboration with backend partners on API contracts.

 **Additional Information**

**Required Tools & Platforms**

* TypeScript, React, and React Router.
* Webpack, with Module Federation or a similar remote-module architecture.
* SCSS/CSS Modules and Styled Components.
* GraphQL, Apollo Client, and GraphQL Code Generator or similar tooling.
* Jest, React Testing Library, and TestCafe, Cypress, or Playwright.
* GitLab CI or equivalent, Git, ESLint, and Prettier.
* Shared design systems, localization workflows, and automated accessibility testing tools.

**Location, Time & Engagement**

* Candidates must be based in an eligible APAC location.
* India Standard Time (IST) coverage is required.
* Remote contract engagement for 40 hours per week.
* Start as soon as possible; expected engagement through March 31, 2027.
* Two openings are available.
* This is not currently a contract-to-hire opportunity.

title: Senior SW Engineer - Python/Java, API, Angular/React, Cloud, DevOps
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Visa’s Technology Organization** is a community of problem solvers and innovators reshaping the future of commerce. We operate the world’s most sophisticated processing networks capable of handling more than 65k secure transactions a second across 80M merchants, 15k Financial Institutions, and billions of everyday people. While working with us you’ll get to work on complex distributed systems and solve massive scale problems centered on new payment flows, business and data solutions, cyber security, and B2C platforms.

**The Opportunity****:**

Visa's Public Cloud Infrastructure Engineering team is responsible for building and operating secure, scalable, and highly available cloud platforms that power mission-critical applications across Visa. Our team develops reusable infrastructure products, Kubernetes platforms, automation frameworks, and cloud governance solutions that enable engineering teams to innovate safely at scale.

**Responsibilities:**

We are looking for Versatile, curious, and energetic Software Engineers who embrace solving complex challenges on a global scale. As a Visa Software Engineer, you will be an integral part of a multi-functional development team inventing, designing, building, and testing software products that reach a truly global customer base. While building components of powerful payment technology, you will get to see your efforts shaping the digital future of monetary transactions.

**The Work itself:**

* Design code and systems that touch 40% of the world population while influencing Visa’s internal standards for scalability, security, and reusability
* Collaborate multi-functionally to create design artifacts and develop best-in-class software solutions for multiple Visa technical offerings
* Actively contribute to product quality improvements, valuable service technology, and new business flows in diverse agile squads
* Opportunities to make a difference on a global or local scale through mentorship and continued learning opportunities

**Essential Functions:**

* Design, build and manage data ingestion pipelines using multiple technology technical stack including OpenSearch, Kafka, and Druid using open-source packages.
* Design and Build Application in Dockers and Kubernetes
* Develop and Build Python Based application for Automation and Task management.
* Ensure data integrity, quality, and security throughout the data lifecycle end-to-end in open-source platform.
* Build multiple data pipelines to ingest unstructured data in real time for advance data analytics.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.

\*\*We do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have exciting team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa.

This is a hybrid position. Hybrid employees can alternate time between both remote and office. Employees in hybrid roles are expected to work from the office 2-3 set days a week (determined by leadership/site), with a general guidepost of being in the office 50% or more of the time based on business needs.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**: -

  

* 3+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor’s degree, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience

**Preferred Qualifications**: -

* 3-6 years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. M.E/M.Tech, MCA)
* 3-6 years of experience in Python OR JAVA.
* 3-6 years of experience in REST APIs and working with JSON based integration.
* 3-6 years of experience in UI technologies like Angular JS and React.
* 3-6 years of experience in Ansible and other configuration management tools.
* 3-6 years of experience in Docker and Kubernetes (highly preferred).
* 3-6 years of experience in Cloud Applications (highly preferred).
* Experience with source control systems such as **Git**.
* Experience with infrastructure automation, platform engineering, or DevOps.
* Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent Communication and Collaboration skills.
* Experience with Cloud-based Data Engineering solutions is preferred.
* Experience with Container Kubernetes Technologies and knowledge in Hybrid cloud environment
* Experience in Ansible and other configuration management tools.
* Knowledge in Generative AI or Generative AI tools is preferred.
* Explored practical applications of AI and intelligent automation to improve engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
* Participated in Agile planning, technical design discussions, demonstrations, and knowledge-sharing sessions
* Developed integrations between infrastructure platforms, APIs, databases, and enterprise systems
* Apply good software engineering practices including code reviews, automated testing, version control, CI/CD, documentation, and observability.

**The Skills You Bring:**

* Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scale
* Challenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing the boundaries, ‘hacking’ beyond traditional solutions

Builder: Experience building and deploying modern services and web applications with quality and scalability  
Learner: Constant drive to learn new technologies such as Angular, React, Kubernetes, Docker, etc.  
Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, Dev-ops, and Agile/Scrum teams

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Frontend Desktop Engineer (Internal)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web.
  
Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com  
  
Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data.
  
Learn more about Keet: keet.io

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication.

  

* Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications.
* Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).
* Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.
* Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications.
* Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.
* Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).
* Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication.
* Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.
* Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc).
* Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**
